response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in expirespot are excluded. Standard SQL comparison operators (> and <) return FALSE when either operand is NULL, so rows with missing expiry times are not counted. This is likely the intended behavior for this query.
